prompt: I have a stack of three branches: feature-a, then feature-b on top of it, then feature-c on top of that. feature-b's top commit is titled 'WIP: refactor helpers'. I want to push these and open PRs on GitHub. How do I do this with git-stack and gh? Explain what will actually get pushed and why. Don't push anything yet.

assertions.text: Uses `git-stack --push` (a flag on the top-level command), not a `git-stack push` subcommand
Explains only the root/bottom branch (feature-a) is 'ready'; branches stacked on other dev branches are held back
Identifies the 'WIP:' commit on feature-b as a blocker and suggests rewording/finishing it
Recommends one-PR-at-a-time strategy and/or setting each gh PR base to the branch below it (not all onto main)
